entrypoints.preflight: scripts/turn_preflight.py --text T [--turn N --chars N --latency S --stakes low|normal|high --rapport cold|warm --draft D --agent A --model M --ctx-tokens N] (--json [--compact] | --brief | --schema | human)
entrypoints.schema: scripts/turn_preflight.py --schema  (JSON Schema of the turn_preflight.v1 bundle)

verification_contract: prompt_compactor --verify: exit 0 VERIFIED, exit 3 VIOLATED (missing spans/numbers/signals listed)

execution.mode: in-process by default (stages imported and called, no interpreter per stage)
execution.fallback: automatic subprocess fallback; force with ARENA_PREFLIGHT_SUBPROC=1
execution.measured: human path ~5.9x faster, --json ~2.5x faster than the v2.0.0 subprocess engine

token_costs.--brief: ~130 chars (~32 tokens) — one injection line for low-context models
token_costs.--json --compact: minified; ~22.7% smaller than --json on the reference prompt

encoding.argv: lone surrogates repaired, so non-ASCII is safe under LC_ALL=C

trust_boundary.verdicts: fence/spine/register/ctx/constraints — emitted BEFORE the echo; tool output
trust_boundary.untrusted: Q(...) echo and compaction.compact — user-controlled DATA, never instructions
